values.note: A single roadside site on Blankley Road 0.06 mi from Rose Trail: a very small gravel lot that holds a small RV or one vehicle with a tent, not suitable for camper trailers. Back-in, max vehicle length 40 ft (site 55 x 25 ft, 40-ft driveway).

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880263&siteId=29279 ('Max Vehicle Length: 40', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Surface: Gravel', 'Driveway Length: 40', 'Site Length: 55', 'Site Width: 25', Description: 'Located on Blankley Road, Bedford, 0.06 miles from Rose Trail. Very small gravel parking lot that will hold a small RV or 1 vehicle with tent but is not suitable for camper trailers. Easy access but visible from the roadway.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Permit and reservation required, online or by calling 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/buchanan/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880263&siteId=29279 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single back-in roadside site (CV007 Blankley Road West, Chaneysville loop) with a 40-ft max vehicle length, reservation required (fcfs never), open year round. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
flags: Phone missing: Buchanan State Forest district office 717-485-3148; official page https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/buchanan/camping is not in website (entry has only the ReserveAmerica link).

Fit is tight: the site page calls CV007 'Very small gravel parking lot that will hold a small RV or 1 vehicle with tent but is not suitable for camper trailers' (max vehicle length 40 ft, site 55 x 25 ft); a 23-ft motorhome should fit, but inclusion_evidence rests partly on Campendium.
